name: Anastasha Rachel Gunawan
bio: I am an artist, technologist, and inquirer; I coax the collective imagination through technologies for ritual and magic. My practice of inquiry involves the creation of these handmade technological artifacts, designing interventions (spaces, events, media) to invite more of them, and reading ancient & new texts about technological discovery/fear/hope. They remind me that we are moving in cycles, re-encountering ourselves time & again.

name: Shawn Smith
bio:
Shawn's work sits at the intersection of AI, behavior, and community — translating systems thinking into experiences that feel emotionally resonant, socially meaningful, and practically useful.

Before graduate school at Stanford, he led data teams and built data-driven products inside large organizations, bringing technical depth, product strategy, and organizational leadership to complex human problems. He is now focused on shaping emerging technologies, especially AI, in service of care, connection, and human flourishing.
